text.en:
Rehabilitation and Reconstruction from General Revenue and/or Loans. For the purpose of
implementing the program of rehabilitation and reconstruction, the following sums, or so much thereof as may
be necessary, are hereby appropriated, out of the general funds in the National Treasury not otherwise
appropriated and/or from proceeds of local and/or foreign loans, for the rehabilitation and reconstruction of
the projects summarized hereunder and listed in Annex I:
A. School Building

C. Flood Control
D. Irrigation
D IRRIGATION
Name of Project
Appropriations
1. For the rehabilitation and reconstruction of national irrigation systems
2. For the construction, rehabilitation, and reconstruction of communal irrigation projects and systems
3. For pump irrigation systems procurement of equipment and accessories, pre-engineering construction and
rehabilitation of existing systems
=

This amendatory Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 20th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
